<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def whitebar(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); row=a[0]; return len(row.split('c')[0].replace('S','').replace('W','W')) if 'c' in row else None
def wb(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')[0]; i=a.find('c'); return i
def reds(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','g','G'):
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            out.append((n['color'],(r0,c0,r1,c1)))
    return sorted(out)
print('whitebar start col:', wb(current_frame))
r=action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT'])
print('after LEFTx3: done=',r.get('done'),'level_completed=',r.get('level_completed'),'game_over=',r.get('game_over'),'board_changed=',r.get('board_changed'))
print('whitebar col:', wb(current_frame))
print('reds:', reds(current_frame))
# chair bbox
W=[n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>100]
if W:
    n=W[0]; r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']);r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
    print('chair bbox',(r0,c0,r1,c1))
</parameter>
</function>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def whitebar(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n'); row=a[0]; return len(row.split('c')[0].replace('S','').replace('W','W')) if 'c' in row else None
def wb(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')[0]; i=a.find('c'); return i
def reds(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('R','g','G'):
            r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            out.append((n['color'],(r0,c0,r1,c1)))
    return sorted(out)
print('whitebar start col:', wb(current_frame))
r=action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT'])
print('after LEFTx3: done=',r.get('done'),'level_completed=',r.get('level_completed'),'game_over=',r.get('game_over'),'board_changed=',r.get('board_changed'))
print('whitebar col:', wb(current_frame))
print('reds:', reds(current_frame))
# chair bbox
W=[n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>100]
if W:
    n=W[0]; r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary']);r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
    print('chair bbox',(r0,c0,r1,c1))
